name: utc-epoch
title: UTC <> Epoch
description: A extension for seamless to and fro time conversion between UTC and Epoch
author: imsamimalik

commands.name: utc-to-epoch
commands.title: UTC → Epoch
commands.description: Convert selected UTC date-time to epoch seconds and paste

commands.name: epoch-to-utc
commands.title: Epoch → UTC
commands.description: Convert selected epoch to ISO UTC and paste

commands.name: auto-convert
commands.title: Epoch ↔ UTC
commands.description: Detect selection and convert to the other format

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
